question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus the new SDK budget helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold token headroom into the broader assemble metadata design in #82137?
rationale: This PR changes public plugin API and SDK exports that third-party context engines may compile against, while adjacent assemble metadata design remains unsettled.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Fixes
options.body: Approve the narrow optional field and helper exports after the two patch defects are fixed and real downstream behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and land token headroom together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata contract.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Allow the optional assemble field but remove or defer public helper exports until the SDK helper contract is maintainer-owned.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Fixes
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow optional field and helper exports after the two patch defects are fixed and real downstream behavior proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the strongest recent merged history on the context-engine budget path affected by this API decision.
